title: [GMCP 203.030.02] Production path: Supply-chain integrity and server/package trust
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-030-02. Implement the canonical state, types, and primary production path. Replace stubs, demo-only paths, duplicated semantics, and implicit ambient state; preserve compatible behavior through explicit adapters; and make the new path reachable from the shipped GMCP runtime. Vector outcome: Every install resolves immutable package identity, source, version, digest, signature/provenance, license, SBOM, vulnerabilities, maintainer and runtime before execution. Lockfiles and trusted publishers prevent substitution and dependency confusion; updates are staged, rescanned, diffed and rollbackable; revoked or newly critical artifacts are quarantined; and offline verification uses retained transparency evidence. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
